pages.title: Galaxy Tank Battle
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Line up laser shots in Galaxy Tank Battle. Judge how each shot will travel before firing, then customize your tank and adapt your aim against different opponents.

pages.title: Spooky Block Blast
pages.creator: GameBerry Studio
pages.description: Fit Halloween shapes onto the grid in Spooky Block Blast. Fill a whole row or column to clear space and keep room for the pieces coming next.

pages.title: Memevo.io
pages.creator: Karma Arcade
pages.description: Collect pellets to evolve in Memevo.io. Pick boost cards, avoid hazards, and charge shots to fight opponents or bosses as you work toward a higher score.

pages.title: Kalulu Tanhulu: ASMR Mukbang
pages.creator: Mirra Games
pages.description: Help Kalulu become a mukbang streamer in Kalulu Tanhulu: ASMR Mukbang. Host streams and try different foods as you build up the character's internet fame.

pages.title: Mahjong Lines
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: Join identical tiles with a clear route in Mahjong Lines. Open up the board by removing pairs and call on a hint if the available connections are hard to see.

pages.title: Survival On Raft Multiplayer
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Gather resources and survive in Survival On Raft Multiplayer. Look for food, stones, and useful materials on the island and collect items such as wood from the ocean.

pages.title: Sort Game Toy Sort
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Sort dolls and toys into matching groups in Sort Game Toy Sort. Clear all the pieces before time runs out, and use help when the remaining toys are hard to organize.

pages.title: Fireside Solitaire
pages.creator: GameBerry Studio
pages.description: Clear columns in Fireside Solitaire by playing a card one rank above or below the open one. Plan a sequence before drawing, since the stock can run out.

pages.title: Mahjong Connect: Spooky
pages.creator: davidgilbert
pages.description: Link identical spooky tiles in Mahjong Connect: Spooky. Pick pairs with no more than two bends between them and clear the full board before the clock runs out.

pages.title: Brainrot Merge
pages.creator: PT Arena Solusi Digital
pages.description: Drop Brainrot characters into the pile in Brainrot Merge. Line up two of a kind so they combine and make space for the stranger characters you unlock.

pages.title: Shipbuilding tycoon
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Manage a shipyard in Shipbuilding tycoon. Build ships to earn profits and use your growing business to open up more vessels to build.

pages.title: Balls Vs Lasers
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Control two balls in Balls Vs Lasers. Watch the incoming beams and change the balls' positions in time to keep both clear of the next hazard.

pages.title: Sum Master
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description: Choose numbers that meet several totals at once in Sum Master. Check the sums for rows, columns, and colored regions before deciding which numbers to keep.

pages.title: Arrow Wave
pages.creator: Nexus
pages.description: Hold to ascend and release to descend in Arrow Wave. Watch the next obstacle as you guide the wave through gaps and try to keep moving.

pages.title: Office Brawl - Room Smash
pages.creator: Mirra Games
pages.description: Fight your way through an office in Office Brawl - Room Smash. Break through furniture and other obstacles as a disgruntled employee and confront the boss.

pages.title: Tangled Snakes - Sort Puzzle
pages.creator: Ropoto
pages.description: Free snakes one at a time in Tangled Snakes - Sort Puzzle. Look for the ones with a clear path and work out which order will undo the tangle.

pages.title: Grukkle Onslaught
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: Place towers to protect the blue portal in Grukkle Onslaught. Cover the approaches before a wave arrives and adjust your defenses as more enemies move toward the gate.

pages.title: Dirty Money The Rich Get Rich
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Tap for money in Dirty Money The Rich Get Rich. Put earnings into the Growth upgrades or investments to change how quickly your funds build up.

pages.title: Zombie Siege.io
pages.creator: Nova Gaming
pages.description: Choose weapons and skills to protect the last base in Zombie Siege.io. Adapt your setup as waves of zombies get harder and try to survive on more maps.

pages.title: Horror Forest Bear
pages.creator: FBK
pages.description: Search a dark forest for honey in Horror Forest Bear. Guide the hungry bear around the dangers in its path and find all the honey it needs.

pages.title: My City Hospital
pages.creator: Yiv.Com
pages.description: Explore the departments in My City Hospital. Place characters in the hospital scenes and act out the work of running a large medical center across seven areas.

pages.title: Hidden Kitty
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Help an older woman track down her cats in Hidden Kitty. Look around the building for the animals hiding in different spots and bring the group together again.

pages.title: Maze Escape : Craft Man
pages.creator: jimo game
pages.description: Pick your way through the doors in Maze Escape : Craft Man. Each one leads deeper into the maze, so watch for the creatures as you look for an exit.

pages.title: Fury Road Zombie Crash
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Drive a modified car through undead territory in Fury Road Zombie Crash. Keep moving across the landscape and use your vehicle to get through the zombies in your path.

pages.title: Nose Hospital
pages.creator: BPTop
pages.description: Take care of patients in Nose Hospital. Work through the nose surgery activities in the operating room and use the tools the game provides for each step.

pages.title: Fish Story 3
pages.creator: SOFTGAMES – Mobile Entertainment Services GmbH
pages.description: Make groups of three with a mermaid guide in Fish Story 3. Complete underwater puzzles, and visit the Daily Missions or Daily Challenge for more goals and rewards.

pages.title: Crash Car Parkour Simulator
pages.creator: Mirra Games
pages.description: Test cars against presses and giant hammers in Crash Car Parkour Simulator. Time your approach through each obstacle and see whether the vehicle can reach the finish.

pages.title: Emilys Journey
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Search for an archaeologist in Emilys Journey. Click through different locations for clues and solve riddles to find out what happened to Aunt Hilda.

pages.title: Makeup & Makeover Girl Games
pages.creator: ARPAPLUS
pages.description: Try different cosmetics and haircuts in Makeup & Makeover Girl Games. Experiment with shimmer, glitter, and other finishes to build a look for your model.

pages.title: Love Pins Save The Princess
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Release pins to rescue the princess in Love Pins Save The Princess. Check what each pin is holding in place and use the layout to deal with monsters.

pages.title: Scythe death blow
pages.creator: Maksim Popov
pages.description: Clear the monsters in twenty seconds in Scythe death blow. Send your scythe through the map and use its obstacles and skills to reach every target.

pages.title: Hero Cant Fly
pages.creator: grimmtec
pages.description: Jump up steps in Hero Cant Fly. Hold to make a higher jump and release as you watch for flying boxes that can interrupt the climb.

pages.title: Doc Darling Santa Surgery
pages.creator: iclickgames
pages.description: Help Santa after a crash in Doc Darling Santa Surgery. Repair the sleigh, find his reindeer, and take him to Doc Darling to work through his treatment.

pages.title: Save The Uncle
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description: Choose which pins to pull in Save The Uncle. Look for traps and giant spiders first, then release the parts of the puzzle in a safe order.

pages.title: Crime Moto Racer
pages.creator: Berezka
pages.description: Weave through highway traffic in Crime Moto Racer. Find safe gaps while keeping up speed and use the money you earn to buy a different motorcycle.

pages.title: Fight Simulator 3D
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Aim your weapon in Fight Simulator 3D. Set up a fighting pose that lets you reach the opponent, then work through the duels to unlock more levels.

pages.title: Idle Lumber Hero
pages.creator: DesertFoxGaming
pages.description: Move along the trees and chop wood in Idle Lumber Hero. Sell the lumber at the market and invest the proceeds in upgrades that speed up the work.

pages.title: Keeper of the Grove 2
pages.creator: Booblyc OU
pages.description: Grow defenders to protect crystals in Keeper of the Grove 2. Position them along the path and start the next wave when you're ready for the creatures.

pages.title: Pop Christmas
pages.creator: GamesFine.com
pages.description: Tap groups of identical holiday items in Pop Christmas. Clear at least two together and look for bigger groups when you want more points per piece.

pages.title: Squidly Game Tug Of War
pages.creator: Hihoy
pages.description: Pull the rope faster than your opponent in Squidly Game Tug Of War. Press the controls in quick succession to drag the other side across before they pull you off.

pages.title: Onet Animals
pages.creator: Gamesonline.co.id
pages.description: Connect matching animals in Onet Animals. Select pairs you can link and clear tiles that make other animals easier to reach as the board opens up.

pages.title: Craft Punch 2
pages.creator: FBK
pages.description: Hit Steve and let humans pass in Craft Punch 2. Use the left and right controls and react to what appears in the middle. Play alone or with another player.

pages.title: Astronaut Steve
pages.creator: FBK
pages.description: Jump through twenty obstacles and layouts in Astronaut Steve. Tap to make Steve leap and help him travel across the levels in search of the woman he loves.

pages.title: Shaun The Sheep Sheep Stack
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Pull back the sheep's trousers to launch it in Shaun The Sheep Sheep Stack. Aim each sheep onto the stack and keep building until you reach the window.

pages.title: Astrology Word Finder
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Find words about planets and zodiac signs in Astrology Word Finder. Drag to highlight an answer and remember to check for words written backward as well as forward.

pages.title: Cube Tower Surfer
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Steer toward cubes in Cube Tower Surfer. Collect them to build a taller stack under your rider and try to carry more cubes to the end for a higher score.

pages.title: Mermaid Princess Adventure
pages.creator: babygames.com
pages.description: Follow Ariel after she saves a prince in Mermaid Princess Adventure. Work through the fairy-tale activities as she takes a magic potion and sets out with human legs.

pages.title: Archero
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Use a bow against fantasy creatures in Archero. Develop your equipment as you go and work through the encounters leading to the evil dragon.

pages.title: Gravity Climb
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Move a climbing box past spikes in Gravity Climb. Tap in time to change its path and watch where the next hazard sits before making another move.

pages.title: Find Animals Pair
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Turn over animal tiles in Find Animals Pair. Remember which animal appeared in each spot and match every pair as quickly as you can to clear the level.

pages.title: Cartoon ATV Slide
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Slide tiles to rebuild cartoon ATV pictures in Cartoon ATV Slide. Choose one of three images and a mode, and use the wheels and outlines to check your progress.

pages.title: Blockcraft Cars Jigsaw
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Rebuild block-style vehicle pictures in Blockcraft Cars Jigsaw. Pick one of twelve images and choose a layout with 25, 49, or 100 pieces.

pages.title: Donuts Crush
pages.creator: Online Games io
pages.description: Match three doughnuts in Donuts Crush to work toward the level goal. Make combinations that produce boosters and use them when another part of the board needs clearing.

pages.title: Good Pizza Delivery Boy
pages.creator: toplight studio
pages.description: Follow delivery arrows through city traffic in Good Pizza Delivery Boy. Find a quick route on your motorcycle and get the pizza to its destination on time.

pages.title: Kids Mathematics Game
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Pick the missing arithmetic sign in Kids Mathematics Game. Check which operation makes the numbers and result agree, and solve as many equations as possible in two minutes.

pages.title: Cartoon Farm Traktors
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Assemble a chunky tractor puzzle in Cartoon Farm Traktors. Look at the shape of each piece and place it where it completes the cartoon vehicle.

pages.title: Offroad 4x4 Heavy Drive
pages.creator: BestCrazyGames.com
pages.description: Take a heavy four-wheel drive through forest routes in Offroad 4x4 Heavy Drive. Use WASD to keep the vehicle under control as you work through the levels.

pages.title: Five Hoops
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Shoot baskets against other players in Five Hoops. Time each release to reach the hoop and try to finish the course before the other shooters.

pages.title: Helicopter Parking Simulator Game 3D
pages.creator: zuma studio
pages.description: Follow checkpoints in Helicopter Parking Simulator Game 3D. Start the engine with Shift, then use the flight controls to reach each marked location before time runs out.

pages.title: Love Snowballs Xmas
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description: Draw lines to reunite snowmen in Love Snowballs Xmas. Click or tap and drag to shape a path that brings the two snow characters together.

pages.title: Baby Hazel School Hygiene
pages.creator: Baby Hazel
pages.description: Help Hazel prepare for a school inspection in Baby Hazel School Hygiene. Work through the hygiene routines her mother teaches and follow the instructions from her teacher.

pages.title: Running Ted
pages.creator: PetrosMedia
pages.description: Keep moving through Ted's world in Running Ted. Use X to run and M to jump when something blocks the route, then try to go farther.

pages.title: Javelin Olympics
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Throw a spear for distance in Javelin Olympics. Use the tutorial to learn the release, then adjust your attempts as you try to send it farther.

pages.title: Monster Truck Dirt Rally
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Race monster trucks over dirt and steep hills in Monster Truck Dirt Rally. Manage your approach through rough sections and keep the truck moving toward the finish.

pages.title: Mr Bullet 2
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Use objects to deflect your shots in Mr Bullet 2. Aim so the bullet reaches enemies you can't hit directly and clear each arrangement before continuing.

pages.title: Angry Shark Online
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Guide a shark through a city in Angry Shark Online. Use the arrows and space to attack as you take on boats and other targets while trying to survive the trip.

pages.title: Word Chef
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Find the hidden words in Word Chef. Use the mouse to try letter combinations and work out which words the kitchen-themed puzzles are asking for.

pages.title: GTA Vehicle Puzzle
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Rebuild pictures of vehicles in GTA Vehicle Puzzle. Choose Easy, Medium, or Hard and use details in each image to find how the jigsaw pieces fit.

pages.title: EG Contrast
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: Steer through a fast-moving tunnel in EG Contrast. Watch how the colorful obstacles are arranged and look for a safe opening before you reach them.

pages.title: Ice Queen Beauty Makeover
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Give the Ice Queen a skincare session in Ice Queen Beauty Makeover. Help her freshen up after her ride, then choose how to style her finished look.

pages.title: Color Flow
pages.creator: Graviton Digital
pages.description: Catch falling stars in Color Flow. Watch where they're coming from and adjust to the quicker pace as you try to improve your leaderboard score.

pages.title: Bounce Bounce Panda
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Keep a panda bouncing in Bounce Bounce Panda. Time your moves around the dangers in its mountain temple and see how long you can keep it going.

pages.title: Couple Fashion
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Dress two people for a first date in Couple Fashion. Try different fashion pieces and put together an outfit for each of them before they meet.

pages.title: Jigsaw Puzzle: Cats
pages.creator: Physical Form
pages.description: Put together sixteen cat pictures in Jigsaw Puzzle: Cats. Pick a scene and work through the pieces using outlines, fur colors, and background details.

pages.title: FreeThrow.io
pages.creator: DAB3Games
pages.description: Race another shooter in FreeThrow.io. Line up your baskets and try to put more through the hoop than your opponent within sixty seconds.

pages.title: Sailor Scouts Summer Style
pages.creator: GAMEGOS
pages.description: Style the Sailor Scouts for their plans in Sailor Scouts Summer Style. Choose summer clothes that fit where each scout is going during her break.

pages.title: Princesses Statement Hills Obsession
pages.creator: Games Banner Network
pages.description: Shop for high heels with Elsa, Belle, and Ariel in Princesses Statement Hills Obsession. Try pairs from the boutique sale and choose which shoes suit each princess.

pages.title: Princess Best Anniversary
pages.creator: Games Banner Network
pages.description: Prepare an anniversary surprise in Princess Best Anniversary. Choose a gift for the prince and help the princess get ready to celebrate the day they met.

pages.title: Extreme Car Parking
pages.creator: QkyGames
pages.description: Steer into parking spaces in Extreme Car Parking. Work through the driving layouts carefully and line up the car before making the final turn into the bay.
